system.name: HyperET
system.one_liner: Efficient training of multimodal LLMs in hyperbolic space: a learnable scaling matrix adjusts the hyperbolic radius of visual representations on top of frozen pretrained weights.

content.variant_note: a small Input to Output block tied by two dashed lines to a large zoomed module whose four sibling scaling matrices form the design family
content.argues: Hyperbolic radius adjustment multiplies the pretrained weights with a structured, learnable scaling matrix, and the structure (diagonal, block-diagonal, banded, full) trades trainable parameters against flexibility.
content.subject: The HRA module in hyperbolic space with four structured scaling matrices and the pretrained weight matrix, plus the Euclidean-to-hyperbolic data path around it.

lessons.what_to_learn: Present a family of structured parameterisations as same-size grids whose coloured cells show which entries are tunable, and order them with a spectrum banner (efficient to flexible) beneath; tie the small block diagram to the zoomed module with dashed lines.
lessons.suits: Parameter-efficient tuning or structured-matrix methods where the structure of a weight update is the contribution.

evidence: we efficiently train MLLMs in hyperbolic space by adjusting the hyperbolic radius using a tunable scaling matrix Ws
Ws can be configured into three parameter-efficient variants, i.e., Diagonal, Block-Diagonal and Banded.
applying learnable scaling matrices to the frozen pre-trained weights W0 in hyperbolic space

summary: HyperET trains multimodal LLMs efficiently by adjusting the hyperbolic radius of visual representations with a learnable scaling matrix applied to frozen pretrained weights through Möbius multiplication. Figure 1 shows a small block at the right (Input, Euclidean pretrained weights W0, an exponential map into hyperbolic space where HRA acts, a logarithmic map back, Output) tied by two dashed lines to a large Hyperbolic Radius Adjustment Module. Inside, a pink Scaling Matrix panel lines up four n by n grids (Diagonal, Block-Diagonal, Banded, Full) whose blue tunable cells differ, then the Möbius multiplication sign and the pretrained weight matrix. A banner arrow orders the variants from efficient (n) to flexible (n²) and a legend keys the glyphs.
summary_zh: HyperET 在双曲空间用可学习缩放矩阵调整视觉表示半径，高效训练多模态大模型。图1右侧小框为输入、指数映射、HRA、对数映射、输出，虚线放大为 HRA 模块：四种缩放矩阵与预训练权重做 Möbius 乘法，箭头按参数量排序。
notes: The Full matrix is drawn as a reference beside the three variants named in the caption. The matrices, the geodesic background and the legend swatches are bitmaps (12 placed). The #59d3ff share in the digest is not matched to a visible element and is left out of the palette.
